subject: RetailNova — hosted API tier reband & flexible overage lanes
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@retailnova.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@retailnova.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion — capacity step-up and overage flexibility

Hi Stephanie,

We’re kicking off our renewal conversation for Q1 and have an ask: over the past 6 months our hosted API usage has spiked around seasonal promos and we need a cleaner commit + overage structure. High-level:

- Looking to increase committed monthly tokens from 6M -> ~12M.
- Need a flexible overage lane (soft cap + burst pocket) to avoid 429s during promos.
- Interested in any rateband discounts for steady higher commit, and whether rate limits per-second change with higher tiers.

Can you put together a proposal (pricing + SLOs + billing cadence) so I can loop Procurement? We’d like options: 12M commit + small burst pocket, and 18M commit as a second option.

Thanks — copying procurement (Procurement) so they can review terms.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Platform, RetailNova

--
RetailNova | elena.park@retailnova.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@retailnova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — capacity step-up and overage flexibility

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. I’ve sketched two options and attached a compact spreadsheet (RN_renewal_proposal_v1.xlsx) with per-token economics, burst pocket sizing, and a suggested SLA. Quick summary below:

Option A (12M commit):
- Monthly commit: 12,000,000 tokens
- Burst pocket: 2M tokens/month (softly capped, throttled after 95% used)
- Unit rate: $1.30 per 1k tokens (first 12M), $1.75 per 1k tokens over soft cap
- Per-second rate limit: stays at 30 req/s per route, can be increased with Dedicated routing (ask if needed)

Option B (18M commit):
- Monthly commit: 18,000,000 tokens
- Burst pocket: 4M tokens/month
- Unit rate: $1.10 per 1k tokens (first 18M), $1.60 per 1k tokens over soft cap

We can stage a 60-day ramp and prorate billing for the first month. I’m cc’ing Karthik, Marcus, and Jordan to confirm commercial flexibility and ops constraints.

I’ll follow up with a formal SOW + DocuSign link once we align on which option you prefer.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: FW: RetailNova capacity ask — pricing guardrails and concession plan

Folks — quick internal note before we finalize the external SOW:

Context: RetailNova is strategic (marketing + checkout flows), usage spiky but predictable seasonally. Recommended approach:

- Lead with Option A (12M) as baseline — easier to justify to procurement and gives room to add burst.
- Offer a one-time promotional credit for first-month overage (prorated) if they sign within 30 days.
- Include a "burst top-up" clause: additional burst pocket purchasable mid-term at a fixed uplift (15%).
- Maintain current 30 req/s route-level limit; add optional per-route soft limits and autoscaling (ops to confirm).

Marcus — can you confirm the burst enforcement behavior and whether we can promise a 95% throttle threshold (soft) before fallback to backlog? Jordan — flag any DocuSign/deal desk approvals required for the 15% mid-term top-up.

Karthik
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@retailnova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: RetailNova hosted API — stepped commit + flexible overage (SOW attached)

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the details — we’re ready to move forward. Attached is a short SOW (RetailNova_SOW_v1.pdf) and the proposal sheet for the two options. Summary of the formal offer below:

Offer summary (pick one):

Option A — 12M monthly commit
- Monthly commit: 12,000,000 tokens
- Burst pocket: 2,000,000 tokens (softly enforced; throttled after 95% consumption of burst)
- Unit rate: $1.30 / 1k tokens for committed volume, $1.75 / 1k tokens over the soft cap
- Billing cadence: monthly, prorated first invoice for the partial cycle

Option B — 18M monthly commit (preferred economics)
- Monthly commit: 18,000,000 tokens
- Burst pocket: 4,000,000 tokens
- Unit rate: $1.10 / 1k tokens for committed volume, $1.60 / 1k tokens over the soft cap

Operational notes:
- Route-level throughput: default 30 req/s per route; we can configure per-route autoscale policies but that requires a brief ops onboarding (2–3 business days).
- SLOs: 99.9% availability for hosted API; latency targets unchanged.
- Promo: sign within 30 days -> one-time overage credit equal to 10% of first month commitment (applied to first invoice).

Next steps: if this aligns, I’ll send a DocuSign link for the SOW and the amended order form (link below). We can also add a short appendix to modify billing cycle from calendar month to a 30-day rolling period if Procurement prefers.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/abc123
